description: Defines data structures and classes for managing NGAP UE (User Equipment) contexts, including context list management, with functions for adding, removing, and querying UE contexts, as well as handling identifiers and timers.

classes.name: ngap_ue_context_list
classes.description: Manages a list of NGAP UE contexts, providing methods to add, remove, and find UE contexts based on various identifiers, and handles allocation of RAN UE IDs.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a UE with a specific RAN UE ID, UE index, or AMF UE ID exists in the list.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses the UE context by RAN UE ID, UE index, or AMF UE ID.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds and returns a pointer to the UE context by RAN UE ID or AMF UE ID.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE context with specified UE index and RAN UE ID.

methods.name: update_amf_ue_id
methods.description: Updates the AMF UE ID associated with a RAN UE ID.

methods.name: update_ue_index
methods.description: Updates the UE index and notifier for an existing UE context.

methods.name: remove_ue_context
methods.description: Removes a UE context based on UE index.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of UE contexts managed.

methods.name: allocate_ran_ue_id
methods.description: Allocates and returns the next available RAN UE ID.
